rationale: A bounded cancellation wait is an independent recovery control: it prevents reclaiming or replacing work while the provider may still be terminating it. The name is explicit, uses established duration vocabulary, and belongs with retry and execution-limit controls.
alternatives: Derive it from stale_after_seconds, but provider cancellation latency is distinct from heartbeat staleness.
Remove it only if every provider has a fixed, documented cancellation bound enforced outside the plan.
simplestChoice: Keep one optional integer duration in recovery_policy.
